entities.summary: Carol Guzy is an American news photographer. Guzy worked as a staff photographer for the Miami Herald from 1980 to 1988 and The Washington Post from 1988 to 2014. As of April 2022, Guzy is a contract photographer for ZUMA Press. Carol Guzy was a painters & sculptors from Bethlehem (b. 1956-03-07, Bethlehem). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
